issues.note: The complete 2015 U.S. source contains 2,923 occurrence records with MRACE31=99, MRACE6=9 and MRACE15=99 together. These codes are absent from the corresponding annual layout entries. Their meanings are not established here; they are preserved literally without race-category labels or automatic missing-value conversion. All other nonblank MRACE6/MRACE15 pairs follow the documented aggregation. This is a source-data observation, not a harmonization decision.
